name: Palmvil Haunted Villa
detailed_description:
Palmvil Haunted Villa is a 2D top-down survival horror game where you play as Henry, a paranormal enthusiast who got a request from his friend, the owner of the villa, to investigate it in order to experience the paranormal and to provide him with some answers about the afterlife.

Palmvil villa was built during the 1970s in Las Vegas by an entrepreneur who decided to settle there with his wife and kids. After they moved into the villa, various tragic incidents started occurring. In 1983, his wife died of a terminal illness, and it was said that her spirits used to haunt the place. She loved the villa so much when she was alive and thus couldn't move on even after her passing. The entrepreneur moved out of the villa shortly after the incident and put the villa on sale. It was left vacant for years, and there had been break-ins while it was left vacant. It was said that a group of unknown individuals had performed Satanic rituals in the backyard of the house. He was unable to maintain the property anymore, so he sold the villa to Jones.

After six months of purchasing the property, Jones, the current owner of the villa, moved in with his wife and kids. He got an excellent deal during the purchase. Gradually, the paranormal activity started to escalate to the point where he was concerned for the safety of his family. So, he called Henry, the paranormal enthusiast, to check out his haunted villa to help him out and to provide him with the answers.

You play as Henry, a paranormal enthusiast, and you have to investigate his haunted villa as per your friend's request. Are you prepared to face your fears inside the villa?

Key Features:

  • Explore the entire villa for the proof of the paranormal.
  • Come face-to-face with the evil spirits!
  • Collect items like golden and silver keys, the devil ring, hammer etc.
  • Explore the unknown spirit world!
  • About half an hour of paranormal investigation.

Warning:

This game contains flashing lights which may not be suitable for people with epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.
